name: Low-field share of new MR clearances
what_is_measured: The share of new product code LNH clearances below 1 tesla, the contrarian's fifth-future watch row.
cadence: Weekly count; quarterly read of field strength
settles_a_when: It settles no axis. If the low-field share passes one third for two years, the line delivers inside tolerance to a shrinking order book and the grid was the wrong grid.
false_signal: A rise in counts; most LNH clearances are coils and software, not magnets.
last_read: 21 clearances in 2026 to 16 September; field strength not yet tallied.

name: MR on the regulator's shortage list
what_is_measured: Whether any MR product code or helium-dependent imaging device appears on the FDA device shortages list under Section 506J, which is what a procurement team sees before accepting a longer lead time.
settles_a_when: An MR code is listed with helium supply as the reason; this is a lagging confirmation of U2 end A, not a leading read.
settles_b_when: No imaging code is listed through 2028 while Gulf transit normalises.
false_signal: A discontinuance entry for an imaging device, which is a maker's choice.
last_read: Updated 16 June 2026; no imaging code listed.
